intro: Laughing kaomoji (also spelled kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces caught mid-laugh — a small giggle, a big cackle, or rolling on the floor. A laughing kaomoji such as (≧▽≦) or ( ﾟ∀ﾟ)ｱﾊﾊ八八 is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and chats. Browse by volume below and click any face to copy it instantly. Whether you search "laughing kaomoji" or "kaomoji laughing," every face here is free to copy and paste.
